description.zh: 需要升级的目标数据库版本。>您可以调用[describedbclusterversion](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数据库版本的升级说明。
description.en: The target database engine version to which you want to upgrade. > You can call the [DescribeDBClusterVersion](~~196830~~) operation to query the upgrade instructions for all database engine versions in a specific region.

description.zh: 需要升级的目标版本号
description.en: The target version number to which you want to upgrade.

description.zh: 实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in a specific region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 实例所在地域。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region in which the instance resides. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

description.zh:
切换模式。取值：

- 0：立即切换。
- 1：在可运维时间段内切换。
description.en:
The switch mode. Valid values:

- 0: immediately switches.
- 1: switches within the O&M window.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx upgrade-cdc-version --db-instance-name pxc-hzrp00003p72fi --cdc-minor-version polarx-cdc-kernel-5.4.19-20240928_17274884 --cdc-db-version 2.343 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name pxc-shrvdc0000wtf5uk-cdc --switch-mode 0 --region cn-hangzhou
